summary: Backend-only testing for new TAXXA features: Currency auto-detection, Admin gamification dashboard APIs, and Push notification service endpoints. All 15 tests passed after fixing 2 bugs in admin_gamification.py

backend: GET /api/currencies/supported - Returns list of supported currencies including TZS
POST /api/admin/login - Admin login successful with credentials
GET /api/admin/gamification/overview - Requires admin auth (403 without auth)
GET /api/admin/gamification/badges - Returns badge list with earned counts
GET /api/admin/gamification/streaks - Returns streak leaderboard with multipliers
POST /api/user/push-token - Registers valid Expo push token
Tanzania phone (+255) auto-detects TZS currency during registration

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: admin_gamification.py verify_admin_token() was checking for 'type: admin' instead of 'role: admin' - caused 403 errors for admin endpoints
FIXED: admin_gamification.py get_streak_leaderboard() returned MongoDB _id fields which are not JSON serializable - caused 500 error
seed_data_creation: Test users created via API for authentication testing with unique phone numbers
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features tested: 1) Currency auto-detection: /api/currencies/supported returns 30+ currencies, /api/user/currency returns auto-detected currency based on phone number prefix (e.g., +255 -> TZS). 2) Admin gamification APIs at /api/admin/gamification/* - overview, badges, streaks, challenges endpoints all working with admin JWT token. 3) Push notification endpoints: /api/user/push-token for Expo push token registration, /api/user/notification-preferences for managing notification settings. Admin login uses credentials: admin/taxdraw_admin_2024.

bug_1.issue: verify_admin_token() checked for payload.type == 'admin' but admin login returns payload.role == 'admin'
bug_1.fix: Updated to check both formats for backwards compatibility

bug_2.issue: get_streak_leaderboard() returned raw MongoDB documents with _id ObjectId which is not JSON serializable
bug_2.fix: Explicitly build result dict without _id field
